sourceCopy.name: Annuity Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Annuity Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Calculate an annuity’s future value, present value or required periodic payment. Compare payment timing and frequencies with a free local estimate.
sourceCopy.intro: Model a stream of equal payments with a starting amount, rate and schedule. Results are estimates, not a quote or financial advice.
sourceCopy.footerFree: Free browser tools. Your data stays on your device where the tool allows it.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does an annuity calculator work?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: It applies a fixed nominal annual rate divided by the payment frequency to a series of equal payments. Ordinary payments happen at each period’s end; annuity-due payments happen at the beginning. It does not model fees, taxes, variable rates or a specific insurer’s contract.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs in this browser tab and values are not uploaded or saved by this tool.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the difference between present and future value?
additionalFaqs.answer: Present value estimates what a payment stream is worth now. Future value estimates how an initial balance and recurring contributions may accumulate by the end of the schedule.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this predict an annuity contract payout?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It is general arithmetic with the assumptions you enter. Actual products may include fees, guarantees, taxes and terms this calculator does not model.
